sourceDocuments.title: Synthetic irrigation source
sourceDocuments.text: The irrigation prototype records soil moisture throughout the working day. A farm technician reviews each measurement on the water valve. The design connects separate field plots through a shared reporting interface. Each accepted observation receives a time stamp and a location code before storage. The application prepares a watering schedule when the configured conditions are satisfied. Operators examine the recorded information before approving the next action. The study uses the stored observations to describe changes within the monitored area. Local staff retain responsibility for checking unusual entries and correcting inaccurate records. The final report groups the accepted records by collection period and presents the unresolved cases for review.
